kids.name: value-1

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Frames (hand-off §H L97): tile/motion-full · dark; tile/motion-reduced · dark; tile/table-alt · dark

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Data: seeded synthetic stream (seed 1304, BTCUSDT, tick 0.1); sample data, never a market capture (§0 L61); the tick size is the recorded fixture's

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Markers, tags, fold lines and callouts in color.status.info.default are annotation, not product UI

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §6.1 L181: effective motion full (OS no preference, canvas animation on): a heatmap column and a price cell on a 6-second loop; the trail fades and the price flashes once per change (drawn at t = 6 s: 64 250.1 -> 64 251.4, the flash in color.buy.subtle)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: §6 L179: the loop runs while focus or the pointer is in its group (§13.2); a visible Pause (2.2.2, `05`:217), one button whose label swaps Pause / Play, no aria-pressed; drawn focused (CMP-039 normal); a paused tile stays paused for the visit; never above three flashes a second (`05`:218)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Structure (D05-A2): role="group" named in words, the role="img" preview inside, Pause outside the img

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Zero requestAnimationFrame while hidden, offscreen or in a background tab (BQ-5)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §6.1 L181: canvas animation disabled (the row's explicit choice): the loop stops and two still frames sit side by side, "Before" and "After" (W-18), no tween (R-6); the same holds under reduced motion (board 04, following-system)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: No Pause: nothing runs. A preview that animates while demonstrating reduced motion is a defect (T Tech)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The row is modified (§10): "Changed" and its Reset; "Reset this section" under the group

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §6.4 L193: always_show_tables on — the tile's candle chart flips to its CMP-049 table, the same rows, no refetch (S07:24–25); 6 seeded 1-minute candles, high 64 249.3, low 64 244.5 (each row's high >= open, close >= low)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Under reduce the flip is instant; at 400 % the table sits in a named, focusable scroll region ("Sample candle table"), 1.4.10's data-table exception — 400 % is not drawn (§0)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Cells padded 8 px a side; numbers end-aligned in type.num.sm

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: The window is scrolled to Data views (the page top above it, as board 01)

copy_gaps: "Search settings": the settings search's visible label (§10 L249 names the search; no placeholder stands in for a label, `11`:5077)
"Pause" / "Play": the motion tile's one button (§6 L179: "one button whose label swaps \"Pause\" / \"Play\"")

the motion tile's accessible name "Motion preview, full motion: the heatmap trail fades, the price flashes": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"Sample": the focus tile's CMP-001 Button label (§6.2 L185 names the button, not its words)
the focus tile's accessible name "Focus preview: normal ring": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"Reset this section": §10 L248 and §12 name the button; §15 has no W-row for it
the motion tile's accessible name "Motion preview, reduced: still before and after frames": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"Time": a candle-table column header in the table tile (§6.4 L193 names the CMP-049 table, §15 no header)
"Open": a candle-table column header in the table tile (§6.4 L193 names the CMP-049 table, §15 no header)
"High": a candle-table column header in the table tile (§6.4 L193 names the CMP-049 table, §15 no header)
"Low": a candle-table column header in the table tile (§6.4 L193 names the CMP-049 table, §15 no header)
"Close": a candle-table column header in the table tile (§6.4 L193 names the CMP-049 table, §15 no header)
the table-alt tile's accessible name "Table preview: the sample candles as a table": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"Play sample": the announcement tile's button (§6.3 L189; W-27 "Show all" is its label while playing)
the tile's burst line "20 s BTCUSDT burst, 40 prints a second": §7.3 L218's figures, worded by the kit
the announcements tile's accessible name "Announcement preview: On significant change, verbosity Normal": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
